overview_description.description: Ease Health is a New York-based startup offering an AI-native operating system for behavioral health providers. It unifies CRM, EHR, and revenue cycle management (RCM) into a single platform to streamline operations across patient intake, clinical care, billing, and collections. The platform handles the full patient journey, consolidating 6–10 typically separate systems to cut administrative burdens and enable AI-driven automation, such as documentation that reduces note-taking time by up to 50%. It supports diverse care levels, including outpatient, IOP, PHP, residential treatment, detox, inpatient psychiatry, and MAT. Additional tools include patient portals, scheduling, AI patient identification, Power BI dashboards, and compliance features like staff credential tracking.
